brief: A shelf unit rated to hold 50 kg of books, with two drawers.

requirements.requirement: Shelf unit rated to hold 50 kg of books
requirements.evidence: Build is 6x full hex bases in 2 levels (3 at level0, 3 at level1) with 3x hex-bin-full bins as shelves. Geometry is meshClear, but configurator does not validate strength/load as instructed – cannot claim 50 kg rating. No load rating exists in catalog.

Two notch drawer frames placed: notch:0#-1,1#notch0 (hex-drawer-frame-notch-mf) and notch:0#1,-1#notch4 (hex-drawer-frame-notch-mf) – provides two drawer positions. No drawer inserts offered by configurator (find_parts drawer =0, find_sockets drawer=0).

finish.summary: Built compact 2-storey shelf cluster with 3 shelf bins and two drawer frames; meshClear. Load rating 50kg is unmet – system explicitly checks fit not strength and no rated parts exist.

lines.label: M3 x 10 socket head screw, ISO 4762
M6 x 20 socket head screw, ISO 4762

notes: Tighten every M6 to 2 N.m: HAND TOOLS ONLY, never a cordless driver. These bolts clamp printed PETG, not metal: at the bolt's own 10.4 N.m rating the head crushes the plastic under it and the joint fails silently, looking tight while holding nothing. Snug, then a nudge. Re-check the bolts after the first few weeks: PETG relaxes under load and the clamp will have eased.
